title: Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped OSM ring contains the current cylindrical lighthouse shaft.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Copernicus GLO-30 DSM sampled at the foot of the mapped lighthouse, inside the present fish port.

identities.name: Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse
identities.address: Jakarta Fish Port, Muara Baru, Penjaringan, North Jakarta, Indonesia

mapIdentity.scope: OSM way 1359868373 wraps the existing stone shaft at the verified Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse location. The historic photograph identifies its gallery and lantern, and the modern navigation survey gives its 16 m height.

note: The 1875 Woodbury and Page waterfront photograph shows the tapered shaft, two round windows, corbelled gallery and glazed cylinder. The mapped shaft is approximately 3.55 m across.
